name: Alexi Giannoulias
summary:
Alexander Giannoulias ( jə-NOO-lee-əs; born March 16, 1976) is an American politician who has served as the 38th secretary of state of Illinois since 2023. He previously served as the 72nd treasurer of Illinois from 2007 to 2011.
A member of the Democratic Party, Giannoulias defeated Republican nominee Christine Radogno with 54 percent of the vote in the 2006 election for Illinois treasurer.
